description: This header defines Vulkan API types and utilities for tensor data types, including ScalarType enum, format conversions, and GPU memory layout options, used within the Vulkan backend of a deep learning framework.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Enumeration of scalar data types used in Vulkan tensor operations.

methods.name: element_scalartype
methods.description: Returns ScalarType corresponding to a VkFormat.

methods.name: element_size
methods.description: Returns size in bytes of the C type corresponding to ScalarType.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts ScalarType to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs ScalarType as string to stream.
